ScatterPlotDev.title: Entendendo a Matriz
ScatterPlotDev.intro: O Motor de PCA Comportamental (Análise de Componentes Principais) é um módulo avançado de aprendizado de máquina projetado para comprimir matematicamente 8 dimensões de telemetria bruta de governadores (Poder, Pontos de Eliminação, Mortes T4/T5, Vetores de Atividade Online) em um plano de coordenadas visual 2D digerível.
ScatterPlotDev.x_axis_desc: The horizontal axis measures aggregate action volume. A governor placed far to the right (positive X) has exhibited a high magnitude of statistical volatility—meaning massive shifts in power, severe troop deaths, and skyrocketing kill points compared to the baseline population curve. A negative X placement indicates stagnation or extreme passivity relative to the kingdom average.
ScatterPlotDev.y_axis_desc: The vertical axis computes raw sociological efficiency. Governors placed high on the matrix (positive Y) are scoring massive Kill Points while sustaining suspiciously low permanent troop deaths (T4/T5 Deads). Those mapped deep in the negative Y quadrant are 'bleeding out'—absorbing catastrophic permanent troop losses for marginal competitive point gain, serving as structural feeders.
ScatterPlotDev.q_heroes: (Heroes) — High volatility, extreme efficiency. The ultimate elite garrison leaders.
ScatterPlotDev.q_warriors: (Warriors) — High volatility, terrible efficiency. Brutal field fighters absorbing massive losses to win.
ScatterPlotDev.q_farmers: (Farmers) — Low volatility, high power consumption. Visually growing infrastructure but doing zero combat.
ScatterPlotDev.q_slackers: (Slackers) — Low volatility, zero growth. The truly plateaued dead-weight accounts.
ScatterPlotDev.q_feeders: (Feeders) — Low volatility, terrible efficiency. Structurally broken accounts bleeding infrastructure.
ScatterPlotDev.dev_notes_title: NOTAS DO DESENVOLVEDOR (A TEORIA DA MATRIZ):
ScatterPlotDev.dev_notes_1: O Algoritmo de Volatilidade Longitudinal: Para pintar um quadro matematicamente preciso da consistência do jogador, o backend divide dinamicamente o período de tempo solicitado em até 5 pontos cronológicos equidistantes (Início, 3 varreduras intermediárias e Fim), extraindo dados simultaneamente do AWS DynamoDB. Em vez de apenas calcular o 'Total de KP Ganho', o motor calcula o desvio padrão entre esses intervalos discretos. Plotado no Eixo X (Volatilidade), um jogador que joga de forma constante a mesma quantidade toda semana é estatisticamente fundamentado (Variância ~0), enquanto um jogador que fica inativo por 3 semanas e tem um pico massivo na última semana é matematicamente lançado para as bordas explosivas da matriz.

CityHallGuide.pill_free_tool: Public Free Tool • No Login Required
CityHallGuide.hero_desc: Rushing City Hall is the single most vital meta-strategy in Rise of Kingdoms. Unlock higher march queues, T4/T5 troop tiers, maximized Alliance Help efficiency, and territory dominance.
CityHallGuide.card_troop_desc: T3 Troops at CH16; decisive T4 power spike at CH21.
CityHallGuide.card_march_desc: CH 22 permanently grants 5th march for gathering & combat.
CityHallGuide.card_speedup_desc: High Alliance Center cuts hundreds of hours per build.
CityHallGuide.card_peak_desc: Unlocks Academy 25 requirement for Tier 5 military tech.
CityHallGuide.planner_desc: Select your current level and target goal to discover the direct prerequisite chain.
CityHallGuide.rushing_rule_desc: Only upgrade the exact mandatory secondary building required for the next CH. Do NOT level every farm or secondary barrack until your CH milestone is locked.
CityHallGuide.lbl_check_off: Check off as you build in-game
CityHallGuide.goal_25_desc: Reaching CH 25 unlocks max building buffs, 200,000 baseline troop capacity, and qualifies you for Academy 25 (T5 Troops). Note the 3 Master's Blueprints requirement.
CityHallGuide.goal_22_desc: Unlocking your 5th march queue multiplies gathering income and battlefield influence by 25%. Rush straight here before maxing other production buildings.
CityHallGuide.goal_21_desc: T4 units have drastically higher base stats and are mandatory for Ark of Osiris, Expedition, and Kingdom defense.
CityHallGuide.goal_16_desc: Reaching CH 16 gets you into the Feudal Age, unlocking T3 units and standard alliance center help scales.
CityHallGuide.goal_early_desc: Early economy rush. Keep your 2nd builder active 24/7 with VIP 6.
CityHallGuide.tree_desc: Detailed requirements: Every City Hall level requires the Wall at the previous level plus one critical secondary building.
CityHallGuide.no_results: No building requirements found matching your search.
CityHallGuide.walls_desc: Many governors get stuck for months by ignoring special items required for prerequisite structures. Prepare early.
CityHallGuide.wall_1_desc: Watchtower upgrades require Arrows of Resistance. Since Wall level is locked behind Watchtower at later levels, you cannot reach CH 25 without a Level 24 Watchtower.
CityHallGuide.wall_1_tip: Tip: Chain barbarian rallies during Lohar events to stockpile bone necklaces for free arrows without spending precious gems.
CityHallGuide.wall_2_desc: Required to upgrade your Castle. While not directly needed for CH 25, Castle 25 is an absolute requirement for Academy 25 (the gateway to Tier 5 troops).
CityHallGuide.wall_2_tip: Tip: Constantly launch and join level 4/5 Barbarian Forts with alliance members to passively stack books without bleeding gems.
CityHallGuide.wall_3_desc: Every building upgrade from Level 24 to 25 demands exactly 1 Master's Blueprint. To get CH 25, you need at least 3 blueprints (Trading Post, Wall, CH).
CityHallGuide.wall_3_tip: Tip: Buy these during 'More Than Gems' (MTG) event to earn golden commander heads while fulfilling required purchases.
CityHallGuide.opt_desc: Never start a multi-day building upgrade 'raw'. Applying buffs in correct order saves weeks of precious building speedups.
CityHallGuide.step_1_desc: Defeat Holy Site guardians. Pick up a 10% to 15% Building Speed Rune immediately before initiating.
CityHallGuide.step_2_desc: Request the Architect title (+10% Speed) or Duke (+5% speed) via Kingdom chat queue.
CityHallGuide.step_3_desc: Ensure your city is rooted on Alliance territory. Ask officers to activate the alliance building skill.
CityHallGuide.step_4_desc: NEVER apply speedups immediately. Wait until Alliance helps hit 100% capacity before burning items.
CityHallGuide.vip_priorities_sub: Where free gems should go early game
CityHallGuide.vip_6_desc: Permanent 2nd Builder Queue. RUSH THIS WITH GEMS IMMEDIATELY. Never spend gems on tavern keys; rush VIP 6 on day 1 to double construction velocity forever.
CityHallGuide.vip_10_desc: Unlocks 1 Free Legendary Commander Sculpture per day + 15% Building Speed buff.
CityHallGuide.vip_12_desc: Grants 2 Free Legendary Commander Sculptures per day. The staple benchmark for competitive low-spenders.
CityHallGuide.vip_14_desc: Grants 3 Free Legendary Commander Sculptures per day.
CityHallGuide.alliance_math_desc: Each Alliance Help reduces remaining time by 1% of total duration or 1 minute (whichever is greater).
CityHallGuide.alliance_example_desc: On a 10-day (240 hour) upgrade at level 25, 30 helps will automatically erase over 62 hours of build time for free. If you use speedups first, you lose all that value!
CityHallGuide.perk_10: Dark Age unlocked; Military Tech speed
CityHallGuide.perk_24: Training speed +20%, Final bridge to CH 25
CityHallGuide.perk_25: Academy 25 Prereq, T5 Troops Gate, Max Base Stats

BeginnerPlaybook.hero_desc: Essential tactical fundamentals for new accounts and jumpers. Avoid irreversible mistakes, master commander investments, and calculate build times with mathematical precision.
BeginnerPlaybook.veteran_advice_text: Mistakes made in the first 14 days with universal gold sculptures or civilization swaps take months to recover from. Bookmark this guide to review before spending rare items.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_1_title: Never Spend Gems on Tavern Gold Chests
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_1_summary: Gold keys drop naturally every single day from dailies and events. Gems must go to VIP points.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_1_detail: On Day 1, dump free gems straight into VIP to hit VIP 6 immediately. This unlocks the permanent 2nd Builder Queue. After VIP 6, stockpile gems exclusively for the 'More Than Gems' (MTG) event to purchase 8-hour speedups, Master's Blueprints, or push toward VIP 10 (1 free gold head/day) and VIP 12 (2 free gold heads/day).
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_2_summary: NEVER use universal gold heads on commanders obtainable from the golden tavern chest.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_2_detail: Commanders like Charles Martel, Julius Caesar, El Cid, Cao Cao, and Cleopatra can be unlocked and maxed over time for free from gold keys. Every universal gold head you acquire must be hoarded for Wheel of Fortune or Season of Conquest powerhouse commanders (e.g. YSG, Alexander the Great, Scipio Prime, Nevsky). Wasting 50 gold heads on Caesar early on permanently damages your late-game account.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_3_title: Always Max the 1st Skill Before Starring Up (5/1/1/1)
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_3_summary: The active 1st skill is 80% of a commander's combat power. Never unlock star 2 until skill 1 is level 5.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_3_detail: When you upgrade a commander's star rating from 1 to 2 stars, all future skill upgrades are assigned randomly between skill 1 and skill 2. If skill 1 is only level 2 or 3, your precious sculptures might upgrade secondary utility skills instead of the primary nuke. Keep the commander at Level 10 / 1 Star until their 1st skill hits 5/5.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_4_title: Start as China for the 5% Construction Buff
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_4_summary: China gives you Sun Tzu (the best epic commander in the game) plus a permanent +5% building speed.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_4_detail: Building City Hall and prerequisite structures to level 25 takes hundreds of real-time days. China's passive +5% building speed buff shaves weeks of building speedups off your account progression. Once you reach City Hall 25, you can consume your free Civilization Swap token to switch to Germany (5% AP recovery + 5% training speed) or France (healing speed).
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_5_title: Rush Gathering Commanders Straight to Level 37
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_5_summary: Get Constance, Gaius Marius, Sarka, and Centurion to Level 37 to unlock the 'Superior Tools' talent.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_5_detail: You do not need military stats on gatherers. Invest green and blue commander exp to push each gathering commander to exactly Level 37. This grants enough talent points to reach the final node in the Gathering tree ('Superior Tools'), giving +25% gathering speed across all resource types plus 6% extra resources on completion.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_6_title: Never Let Action Points (AP) Sit at 1,000 Cap
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_6_summary: Capped AP is wasted commander experience, speedups, blueprints, and materials.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_6_detail: AP regenerates every second. If your bar is at 1,000/1,000, you are bleeding free resources. Use peacekeeping commanders (Lohar, Markswoman, Boudica, or Aethelflaed) to hunt barbarians. With Lohar's AP cost reduction and bonus experience, you can power-level commanders while stockpiling arrows, gems, and speedups.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_7_title: Create at Least One Dedicated Farm Account
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_7_summary: One single city cannot generate enough food and gold to sustain serious KvK open-field fighting.
BeginnerPlaybook.rule_7_detail: Create a 2nd character in your same kingdom right away. Keep this 'Farm' focused purely on resource production, gathering talents, and trading post upgrades. In KvK 1, a single hour of intensive fighting can cost 100M+ food and wood in hospital heal bills. Your farm account will provide the resources while your main account spends gems on combat tech.
BeginnerPlaybook.cmd_sun_why: The undisputed King of Epics. His active skill hits up to 5 targets for 800 damage factor each, restores 50 rage per target struck, and boosts all skill damage dealt by your army by +20%. He remains competitive even in KvK Season of Conquest!
BeginnerPlaybook.cmd_bjorn_why: Deals direct damage to a single target and immediately amplifies all subsequent skill damage taken by the target by +10% for 3 seconds. When paired with Sun Tzu as secondary, Sun Tzu's massive AoE fires during this vulnerability window!
BeginnerPlaybook.cmd_joan_why: Her active skill buffs all nearby friendly troops: Infantry HP +30%, Cavalry Defense +30%, Archer Attack +30%, and restores 200 rage over 4 seconds. She is the ultimate murder-ball multiplier for canyon, Ark of Osiris, and open field.
BeginnerPlaybook.cmd_baibars_why: The only epic cavalry commander with true AoE. Deals up to 1,000 damage factor to 5 targets and slows enemy march speed by 50% for 2 seconds. In addition, his passive grants +50% march speed after leaving battle, making him lethal for open field hit-and-run.
BeginnerPlaybook.cmd_pelagius_why: Offers consistent cavalry defense, steady healing over 2 turns, and rage restoration (100 rage over 2 seconds) upon skill cast. Highly reliable primary commander for early cavalry marches.
BeginnerPlaybook.card_talents_desc: Remember: Only the Primary Commander's talents apply to your march! The Secondary Commander only contributes their active and passive skills. You do not need to level a secondary commander past Level 30 or 40.
BeginnerPlaybook.card_talents_tip: Tip: Keep secondary commanders at 4 stars / Lv. 30 to unlock all 4 skills cheaply.
BeginnerPlaybook.calc_sub: Calculate your true remaining upgrade time after stacking Holy Site Runes, Kingdom Titles, VIP buff, and Alliance Helps.
BeginnerPlaybook.calc_rule_helps: Rule: Never burn universal speedups until all {count} helps are clicked by alliance members!

EquipmentGuide.title: Ideal Equipment & Commander Pairings
EquipmentGuide.subtitle: From Day 1 budget sets (63d, 135d, 43.75d craft times) to Season of Conquest Best-in-Slot meta gear. Toggle Special Talents to see exact combat math and synergy pairings.
EquipmentGuide.armory_matrix_sub: Click any piece to inspect crafting notes
EquipmentGuide.pairings_desc: Top battle-tested commander duos engineered for this specific equipment loadout.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_subtitle: Avoid wasting thousands of materials. These five cardinal rules separate casual spenders from tournament-grade governors.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_1_title: The Hope Cloak Law (Infantry Chest Priority)
EquipmentGuide.cmd_1_rule: Never craft the Eternal Empire set chest before Hope Cloak.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_1_exp: The Eternal Empire set chest gives Infantry Attack, which provides the lowest combat value. Hope Cloak provides +11% Infantry Defense and +3% March Speed. Because infantry marches are notoriously slow, that 3% speed plus raw defense saves your march from getting isolated and swarmed.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_2_title: Special Talent (+30%) Refined Blues Beat Flat Legendaries
EquipmentGuide.cmd_2_rule: A refined Blue item with Special Talent beats an unrefined Legendary at 1/10th the cost.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_2_exp: Gatekeeper's Shield with special talent provides +10.5% Infantry Health for roughly 30 blue materials. A base legendary weapon requires 120 gold materials (equivalent to 19,200 blue materials!) and provides Attack. Prioritize refining blues and purples to 100% crit before ever touching legendary weapons.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_3_rule: Always forge Chest, Pants, and Helm before touching weapons.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_3_exp: In Rise of Kingdoms combat math, Health and Defense have much higher Effective Hit Point (EHP) multipliers than Attack. Attack only increases slightly how hard you hit, whereas Defense and Health directly cut your hospital severely wounded (dead) rates in half. Always forge Defense/Health armor first.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_4_title: Cavalry Mandate: Ash of the Dawn & Navar's Control
EquipmentGuide.cmd_4_rule: Never forge the 6-piece Hellish Wasteland set for Cavalry.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_4_exp: The 6-piece Hellish Wasteland bonus is inefficient. Instead, stop at 4 pieces (Helm, Chest, Boots, Weapon) and equip Ash of the Dawn (Pants, +12% Cav Health) and Navar's Control (Gloves, +12% Cav Defense). Cavalry inherently lacks native health; without Ash of the Dawn, your cavalry march will melt in 5 seconds.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_5_title: Accessory Priority: Silent Trial & Horn of Fury
EquipmentGuide.cmd_5_rule: Silent Trial and Delane's Amulet carry you from KvK 1 through KvK 3.
EquipmentGuide.cmd_5_exp: Do not waste materials trying to craft early accessories. Farm Sunset Canyon daily to get Delane's Amulet and Silent Trial. When entering Season of Conquest, Horn of Fury is the uncontested #1 accessory to craft first, as cutting your rage cycle translates to 25% higher active skill frequency.
EquipmentGuide.lbl_recommended_pairings: Recommended Commander Pairings For This Setup
EquipmentGuide.lbl_pairings_sub: Equipment stats only shine when combined with proper active skill ordering and talent trees.
